sources.title: New Microsoft Copilot brings Home, Code and Autopilot together
sources.dateEvidence: The source URL places the article in September 2026 and links to the 2026-09-25 original Microsoft announcement.

evidence.quote: This is a preview feature provided under Microsoft Product Terms.
You need to be part of the Frontier preview program to get early access.
Code adds a fourth: small, purpose-built solutions anyone can create to get a job done.
The Code tab in Microsoft Copilot turns what you describe into working software.

evidence.locator: What is Copilot Code, iteration bullet
evidence.quote: You give feedback in plain language, and Copilot Code refines the result. You can revert to an earlier version at any time.
Build interactive apps and publish them to Copilot Managed Runtime that people in your organization can open and use.

evidence.locator: Build locally or in the cloud
evidence.quote: When you build locally, Copilot Code works inside a project folder on your computer.

evidence.locator: Build locally or in the cloud table, Cloud row
evidence.quote: Cloud | In a secure, isolated environment in the cloud. | Use the cloud when you want to share projects with your coworkers.

evidence.locator: Stay in control, default permissions list
evidence.quote: By default, Copilot Code asks for permission to:
Copilot Code works within your Microsoft 365 environment and follows your organization's existing governance, security, and compliance controls.
Administrators can audit the actions Copilot Code takes, including code generated, commands run, and files read or written.
Copilot Code is gated by license and by an organization-level setting, so it appears in the app only after both are in place.
Your organization's admin controls whether Copilot Code is available and can set spend limits.
Auto-approve setting | On | This policy setting controls whether users can let Copilot auto-approve permissions in Copilot Code instead of confirming each action.
Copilot Code execution location | On (cloud only) | This policy setting controls where Copilot Code can run agent sessions: on the user's device, in the cloud, or both.
GitHub connection | Off | This policy setting controls whether users can connect a GitHub account in Copilot Code.

Organizational Data in Copilot Code | On for cloud; Off for local | This policy setting controls whether Copilot Code can use Microsoft Graph / WorkIQ data (teams, documents, emails, calendar) and plugins as context for building artifacts.
Code enables users to build applications and automations using natural language.

claims.wording: Copilot Code is a preview build experience in the Microsoft Copilot app that requires Frontier access; the selected sources do not establish general availability.
Microsoft frames Code as a shift from files alone toward small purpose-built solutions: users describe software in natural language, see a live result, iterate, and can revert to an earlier version.
Cloud projects can publish interactive apps to Copilot Managed Runtime for people in the organization, while local projects work inside a chosen project folder.
Local mode asks for approval by default before network calls, extensions or MCP use, shell commands, or file access outside active projects; cloud mode runs in a secure isolated environment.
Copilot Code follows Microsoft 365 governance, security and compliance controls, and administrators can audit generated code, commands run, and files read or written.

For work accounts, IT must provide a Copilot license and organization-level enablement, and can configure auto-approve, execution location, GitHub connections, organizational data access and spend limits; documented defaults can change during preview.

knownGaps: The selected sources do not establish general availability.
Rollout timing, sign-in URLs, supported platforms and model lists differ across pages or can change during preview, so the package omits them from decision claims.
The sources provide no customer outcomes, savings estimates, adoption figures or pricing.
The package does not treat Copilot Code as GitHub Copilot, GitHub Copilot coding agent, Visual Studio Code, Copilot Studio or Copilot Pages.
